question: Which of the following classification bases of industry applies to the products - cotton, jute, wool, silk textile, rubber, tea, sugar, coffee, and edible oil?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agro-based industries.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Agro-based industries** are the correct answer as all the products listed are derived from **agricultural sources.**
 
• Agro-based industries refer to those industries that rely heavily on **agricultural products **as their raw materials.
 
• **Key industries **are those industries that are considered crucial for the growth and development of an economy, such as **steel, petroleum, and automobile industries.**
 
• **Consumer industries** are those industries that produce goods and services for direct consumption by individuals, such as **food, clothing, and entertainment industries.**
 
• **Mineral-based industries **are those industries that rely on the extraction and processing of minerals and ores, such as **mining and metallurgical** industries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cotton** is a natural fiber that is derived from the cotton plant and is used to produce** textiles and clothing.**
 
• **Rubber** is a natural polymer that is derived from the **sap of the rubber tree** and is used to produce various products, including **tires, footwear, and industrial **products.
 
• **Tea, coffee, and sugar** are agricultural products that are grown and harvested for consumption as **beverages and sweeteners.**
 
• **Edible oil **is a cooking oil that is derived from various plant sources, including **soybeans, sunflowers, and palm** trees.
